subject: MediSight POC playbook, success criteria & exec readout slot
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Hsu <claire@medsight.io>, Robert Jacobs <robert.jacobs@medsight.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Apr 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up & next steps from today’s discovery — proposed POC plan

Hi Claire / Robert,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great discussion on your clinical triage workload and the report-generation latency pain points. Per our call, I’ve pulled together a short POC playbook to align on success criteria, owners, and a recommended 4-week evaluation cadence. High-level summary below; attached is a one-page POC plan and a success-criteria checklist for your team.

Key goals (quick):
- Validate 95th percentile latency under 400ms for patient summary generation at realistic concurrency (15 req/s).
- Maintain model output quality: clinical-accuracy score >= 92% on your annotated prompt set.
- Confirm cost-per-1000-requests target for dedicated CPU/GPU configs.

Proposed timeline & owners:
- Week 0 (this week): finalize test dataset and access to de-identified sample — Claire / Robert to share by Mon.
- Week 1: infra onboarding + baseline run (Marcus leading).
- Weeks 2–3: controlled runs, guardrail checks, and iterative prompt tuning (Vanessa/Marcus).
- Week 4: readout + exec decision window (target the week of May 4).

Immediate asks for your team:
1) Confirm the de-identified sample share (SFTP or Drive) by Monday.
2) Confirm exec readout attendees and two possible 60-min windows the week of May 4.

I’ll coordinate internally on the baseline infra and will put a calendar hold tentatively for May 5 — happy to shift once you confirm.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MediSight-POC-Plan-v1.pdf (1 page), Success-Criteria-Checklist.xlsx (15 rows)

From: Claire Hsu <claire@medsight.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Robert Jacobs <robert.jacobs@medsight.io>
Date: Mon, 27 Apr 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up & next steps from today’s discovery — proposed POC plan

Thanks Vanessa — this looks good and aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications and confirmations from our side:

- Data share: we can provide a de-identified dataset via secure Drive link by EOD Tuesday (I’ll send the link and the data dictionary).
- Success criteria: clinical-accuracy threshold looks fine; we’d like one additional metric — hallucination rate on the summary (define as factual error rate per 100 summaries) with target < 1.5%.
- Exec readout: My manager, Robert, will join. Two windows that week that work for us: Tue May 5 10:00–11:00 PT or Wed May 6 14:00–15:00 PT.

Also, for procurement, we’ll need a short statement of what log data is captured during the POC and how it’s stored — can you add that to the POC doc?

Best,
Claire
Senior Product Manager | MediSight Health
claire@medsight.io

I also added a one-paragraph data handling note under the "Operations" section in the POC doc describing the log types we collect during runs: request/response tokens (de-identified), latency and system metrics, and optional debug traces if you opt-in (kept in a customer-controlled S3 bucket with 30-day retention unless otherwise requested). I attached the updated POC doc to this email.

I’ll lock the provisional readout for Tue May 5 10:00–11:00 PT unless you say otherwise. Marcus will lead the baseline infra setup next Tues/Wed.

- Claire: share de-id dataset + data dictionary by 2026-04-28.

Vanessa / Marcus — thanks for the quick turnaround. A couple of procurement and exec items from my side:
